text:
maria: Quick FYI — I'm running a short night fleet audit for tonight's burst window. Trying to reconcile which racks are in standby vs reserved for active tenants. Can @adeel or @jin confirm the reserved pool assignments?

adeel: On it. I'm pulling the tenancy table now — should have a snippet in a few mins.

maria: Thx. Also need ETA from the vendor for the 6 extra A100 nodes we asked to borrow. We might want to flip a tenant to preemptible if ETA slips. cc @sam

vendor-bot: Vendor update: shipment 3/6 racks left vendor datacenter at 02:12 UTC. Estimated arrival to POP is 05:10 UTC. Accounting flag: pending invoice for overnight standbys.

jin: Re: tenancy table — latest export (filtered):
```
pool_id,reserved_for,tenant_tag,expires_at
pool-09,yes,marketing-demo,2026-03-19T08:00:00Z
pool-14,no,standby,2026-03-20T02:00:00Z
pool-22,yes,platform-loadtest,2026-03-19T23:30:00Z
```
I can move pool-14 to reserved if needed but want ops-sre signoff.

ops-sre: If we flip pool-14 to reserved we should also add a billing tag to ensure the tenant is charged for the burst. Use `billing:night-burst-20260319`. Ops will accept the change but need the PR in infra with the tag applied. :thumbsup:

sam: If vendor ETA is > 04:30 UTC we should preempt one of the non-critical tenants. Suggest sequence: 1) move pool-14 to reserved, 2) patch tenant routing rule to fallback-gpu-pool, 3) kick short-lived jobs.

maria: Sounds good. @adeel can you open a quick PR to tag pool-14? Include the billing tag shown by ops-sre. Keep the change scoped to night-burst only.

adeel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/742 — changes: add label `billing:night-burst-20260319` to pool-14 and update tenant-routing entry. Also added a short terraform plan snippet in the PR.

jin: Nice. I ran the plan locally, diff looks clean. One note: routing rule priority needs to be incremented +10 to avoid overlap with existing canaries. Patch in PR.

vendor-bot: Additional vendor note: invoice for standby extension will be generated if racks remain in transit past 06:00 UTC. Contact acct-pay@vendor.example to request waiver.

maria: Ack. @sam can you hold off preempting until vendor ETA confirmed < 05:00? If it goes past 05:00 we'll start the fallback.

sam: Yep I'll be standing by. If we decide to preempt, I'll post which tenant gets shifted and approximate job impact.

ops-sre: Small ops checklist before we flip:
- confirm billing tag present in infra PR
- ensure canary routing priority adjusted
- add quick smoke test: `curl -H "X-Auth: smoke" https://infer.example/smoke`
- set alert for tokenized failures > 5 in 10m

maria: Great checklist. I'll monitor vendor updates and post again with final decision. Thanks everyone. :eyes:

(04:18 UTC) vendor-bot: Updated ETA: arrival 04:52 UTC; no invoice generated yet.

maria: ETA noted. We're holding off preemptions for now. Will merge PR once ops-sre gives final thumbs.

ops-sre: Reviewed PR, tagging looks good, canary priority adjusted. :white_check_mark: You can merge when ready.

maria: Merged at 04:30 UTC. Leaving this thread open until racks are in.

(04:56 UTC) vendor-bot: Shipment delivered to POP at 04:54 UTC, racks handed to on-site techs, no exceptions reported. Invoice pending but within SLA window.

sam: Confirmed new nodes joined `redwood-dedicated-a100` pool, metrics look normal. Closing loop on this one.

maria: Thanks team — closing thread.
